_comment: Spells a fight against a monster lends the characters facing it, for that fight
(Managers.MonsterLentSpells). The client's data has the spell and nobody who casts it; a guide
says each character gets it when the fight starts. Each row is a guide's word, quoted in its why.
monster   the monster template whose presence lends the spell
spell     the spell put on each enemy character's bar
grade     its grade (1 when left out)

lent.why: The Crujidor de hielo (Frigost; «La marcha de la emperatriz» fights him) wraps himself in Cura Glacial (3443): Invulnerable (state 56) for good. Grieta (3449, French «Craquelure»: 4 AP, range 1, once every 5 turns) deactivates state 56 on him alone (952 on «A,F3370») for a turn, at the cost of 1 MP and 3 range to its caster. «Chaque personnage reçoit au début du combat le sort Craquelure» (JeuxOnLine, «Lumière sur l'ombre»).

The Osamodas invocation of «Tiempo de secretos» (2083) is a Mastermind: its starting spell Espíritus Bestiales (14301) draws a hidden code of four elements (14302, states 1371-1386) and answers each elemental hit with white or black circles (14305, 14304 and its kin). Maestro del Espíritu Telúrico (earth), 2 AP, 10 damage, is one of the four keys. «Vous obtenez quatre sorts élémentaires» (Dofus pour les noobs, «Le temps des secrets»).
